name: UnitedHealth Group
desc:
Customer Care Advocate | $16 - $29/hr | Inbound, No Sales Expectations
Company: Optum Insight (UnitedHealth Group)
Industry: Healthcare / Health Insurance Support
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 You'd be answering a steady stream of incoming calls, somewhere between 60 to 90 a day, from people who need help with a health insurance or benefits related question. Your job is to listen closely, figure out what they actually need, and either solve it on the spot or dig through multiple systems and resources to get them an answer. You'd document everything as you go and team up with other support resources when something needs to be escalated. It's a high call volume role, so you're moving fast, but the company gives you real training and support to build confidence in the role.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: High school diploma or GED, or equivalent work experience
Required Experience: Customer service experience analyzing and solving customer problems, or experience in an office setting using phone and computer as primary job tools. Must be 18 or older
Preferred Experience: Not specified beyond required experience
Required Skills:
Strong customer service and problem resolution skills
Comfort with Windows PC applications and ability to learn new computer systems
Ability to multitask across multiple products and benefit levels
Compassion and patience in support of patient satisfaction
Ability to keep company sensitive documents secure in a dedicated home workspace
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone comfortable handling a high volume of calls throughout the day
Someone who genuinely enjoys problem solving and digging for answers across systems
Someone with prior phone or office-based customer service experience
Someone who can commit to a fixed schedule within the 7am to 5:30pm CST window
Not a Good Fit for
Anyone who struggles with sustained, high call volume environments
Anyone without a dedicated, private home workspace for confidentiality purposes
Anyone who cannot occasionally work overtime as business needs require
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Customer service
High call volume
Health insurance support
Problem resolution
Windows PC applications
Multi-tasking
Patient satisfaction
Call documentation
Benefits navigation
Healthcare industry experience
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you
If the assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen
If the phone screen passes, expect a final interview
Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3 to 15 days on average. Note this posting is only open for a minimum of 2 business days or until enough candidates apply, so encourage quick action.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about a time you handled a high volume of customer interactions while still giving each person quality attention.
Walk us through how you'd research an answer to a complex question across multiple systems.
How do you stay compassionate and patient when a caller is frustrated or confused about their benefits?
What's your experience working with Windows-based computer systems and learning new software?
How do you manage your home workspace to keep sensitive information secure while working remotely?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $16 to $29 per hour, based on experience, education, certifications, and local labor market
Shift: Full-time, 40 hours a week, Monday through Friday, with flexibility required across 8-hour shifts within 7:00am to 5:30pm CST. Occasional overtime may be required based on business need
Benefits: Comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase plan, and 401k contribution
Equipment Provided: Not explicitly stated. Participant is responsible for a UnitedHealth Group approved high-speed internet connection and a dedicated, private workspace
Felony Friendly?: Not stated
Drug Test: Required. UnitedHealth Group is a drug-free workplace, and candidates must pass a drug test before starting
Notes: This is a solid opportunity backed by a large, established healthcare company with real training and growth pathways built in. The pay range is wide, so participants with more relevant experience could land well above entry level pay. Since this posting may close quickly due to applicant volume, it's worth encouraging participants to apply as soon as possible if it's a good fit.
Career Pathway: Customer Care Advocate → Senior Customer Care Advocate → Team Lead or Provider Relations Specialist
training: Monday-Friday, 8am-5pm CST for the first 3-4 weeks
